Tells if the user did anything with a joystick since the last time this was asked, which is handy to find out what to play with.
Asking clears the answer. Plugging in a new joystick counts as using it once.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	If JoyChanged() Then Text 10, 10, "The joystick was used"
	Flip
Wend
```
@param device  The joystick to ask, counted like JoyDeviceCount does. Leave out or use -1 to ask for all joysticks together. Each joystick and all of them together are cleared independently.
@returns True if the joystick was used, False if not or if there is no such joystick.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
